title: Mission APIMpossible - gateway observability record
description: The metadata-only record emitted per inference request. Every field here is either non-sensitive or a protected pseudonymous identifier. Prompt text, model output, tokens, tool arguments, file contents, UPNs, email addresses, and display names are prohibited and have no representation in this schema.

schema_version.description: Incremented when fields are added or semantics change, so queries can detect shape drift.

environment.description: Deployment environment name. Low cardinality; safe as a metric dimension.

correlation_id.description: Canonical application correlation GUID. Telemetry only - never used for authentication or authorization.

trace_id.description: W3C trace identifier, surfaced as operation_Id in Application Insights.

apim_request_id.description: Gateway request identifier from context.RequestId. Distinct from trace_id.

foundry_request_id.description: Backend apim-request-id response header. A support handle for raising a case with Microsoft; NOT a joinable trace segment. Null when the backend did not return one.

tenant_id.description: Validated tid claim. Protected pseudonymous identifier: permitted in access-controlled logs, prohibited as a metric dimension.

object_id.description: Validated oid claim. Protected pseudonymous identifier. Never a UPN, email, or display name, and never a metric dimension because of cardinality limits.

client_app_id.description: Validated azp or appid claim identifying the calling application.

model_deployment.description: Approved deployment name. Low cardinality; safe as a metric dimension.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome. An SSE error can arrive under HTTP 200, so status_code alone does not establish generation success.

failure_category.description: Safe failure taxonomy. Never raw LastError text, backend bodies, or policy source.

apim_duration_ms.description: Gateway-observed duration. For streaming this measures until the stream completes or terminates, not model think time.

usage.description: Nullable by design. Usage may be absent for aborted streams and is ESTIMATED for streaming prompts regardless of policy configuration. Absent usage must never be recorded as zero.

source.description: Whether the counts were reported by the backend or estimated by the gateway. Required so aggregates never conflate the two.
